Package ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.util

Klasse JsonReader<T>

java.lang.Object
ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.util.JsonReader<T>
Typparameter:
T - the type of objects to read and write
public class JsonReader<T> extends Object
Generic JSON reader and writer for lists of objects of type T.

This class provides centralized JSON serialization/deserialization functionality for the entire application. It is configured to work with pure POJOs without requiring Jackson annotations in domain models.
